caption: The drawing depicts an object with a hexagonal glass lantern or container, transparent and framed by thin lines indicating the structure of glass panes set in a metallic frame. The top of the lantern is adorned with an irregular, lumpy gray cap that resembles a metallic or stone-like texture with protrusions and small holes. The lantern is mounted on a cylindrical vertical stem or pedestal that connects to a broad, round base, giving the object stability. The color palette consists primarily of shades of gray, white, and pale blue, with slight shading to indicate light reflection and depth. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or detailing.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
